1. Chapter 5 of the User Guide provides definitions of the various types of intimate violence.
2. The bases given are for any domestic abuse except for year ending March 2008 which is for partner abuse (non-sexual); the bases for the other measures presented will be similar.
3. The sample size is lower from year ending March 2011 to year ending March 2013 due to use of a split-sample experiment. The accompanying methodological note provides further information.

4. Estimates are calculated from the new questions from year ending March 2013 onwards. Previous estimates are calculated from the original questions and an adjustment applied to make them comparable to the new questions.

5. Estimates are calculated from the new questions for year ending March 2011 onwards. Previous year's estimates are calculated from the original questions and an adjustment applied to make them comparable to the new questions.
